title: VTA PCS — Member — Attest — payload
description: A member's client asks its VTA for an anonymous or persona events document: the VTA makes the attestation to the event's identity and signs the document with a key made for it alone, or as the persona. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to; its key is derived from this context's base, for events alone (VTI-EVT-212).

operation.description: Which document to build: vtc/events/anonymous/register, withdraw or checkin, or vtc/events/personas/register.

event.description: The event as the community showed it, carrying `anonymity` (its identity and live classes).

payload.description: The operation's payload without `attestation`: what the client wants registered, withdrawn or checked in.

personaDid.description: For `personaRegister`: the persona to sign as.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Member — Attest — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/pcs/member/attest/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/pcs/member/attest/0.1#response.

document.description: The signed document for the client to send unchanged, from a connection that does not identify the member, after a pause (VTI-EVT-214).

tag.description: The tag the attestation carries, for the client to show the member their registration.
